newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil Singapore shuts 280,000-bpd refinery Mar 15.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Singapore shuts 280,000-bpd refinery Mar 15.

text.p: Mobil Oil Singapore, a unit of U.S. oil giant Mobil Corp has shut down its 280,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery for its scheduled turnaround on March 15, an industry source familiar with the refinery said on Monday.
"Nothing has changed, and the shutdown is on schedule," the source said.
He said the whole refinery will be shutdown for up to six weeks with some staggering of the units, he said.
Last month, a company spokesman said the Jurong plant on the west coast of Singapore will shut for about a month for maintenance and debottlenecking to raise its capacity to 300,000-bpd.
